# pcd_identity_role (Data Source)

Look up a role in PCD's Keystone identity service by name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Restrict the lookup to (and report) this domain.
- `name` (String) Look up the role by name.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `role_id` (String) Look up the role by ID (takes precedence over name).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The role ID.
